title: Write local two-node test environment script
description:
Write scripts/local_dev.sh: starts a local IPFS node (kubo), generates test key pairs, writes minimal transit and reader config files to /tmp/, starts transit and reader as background processes, waits for readiness (polls /health), prints connection info. A companion scripts/local_dev_stop.sh kills all started processes. Artifact: scripts/local_dev.sh, scripts/local_dev_stop.sh.

Acceptance: script starts successfully on a clean Linux system with kubo installed; reader is reachable via `slrn -h localhost` after script completes; stop script kills all processes without leaving orphans
